tools.name: autoposter_list_accounts
tools.description: Lists all connected social media accounts (LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Facebook, Telegram) in the current Autoposter workspace.

tools.name: autoposter_get_rules
tools.description: Returns platform publishing constraints including character limits, media format requirements, and guidelines.

tools.name: autoposter_upload_media
tools.description: Uploads an image or video to Auto Poster media library. Accepts a file object supplied by the client, a public image or video URL, a data URI, or base64 data. Direct chat download limit is 100MB. For larger videos or files (>100MB), tell the user to provide a direct public file URL or use autoposter

tools.name: autoposter_get_media_upload_url
tools.description: Only for clients that can perform an HTTP PUT or multipart POST (not chat-only clients such as Gemini): if you cannot make that request yourself, use autoposter_create_upload_link instead. Generates a presigned S3 upload URL for direct, high-speed upload of videos or images up to 5GB without size li

tools.name: autoposter_create_upload_link
tools.description: Creates a short-lived link where the user can upload images from their device into the Auto Poster media library. Use this when the user wants to attach an image that exists only in the chat or on their device (no public URL) and your client cannot send file contents. Give the link to the user, wait

tools.name: autoposter_draft_post
tools.description: Creates a draft post for human review. If API key lacks direct publish, post is saved as pending_approval and notifications are sent to workspace approvers. tools.name: autoposter_schedule_post
tools.description: Schedules a post for a future date/time. Automatically converts local time using workspace/user timezone into UTC. Accepts mediaUrls (public URLs) or files (client-supplied file objects up to 100MB). For large video files over 100MB, tell the user to provide a direct public file URL or use autoposte

tools.name: autoposter_publish_draft
tools.description: Approves and immediately publishes an existing draft or pending post. Requires an API key with direct publish permission.

tools.name: autoposter_get_post_status
tools.description: Checks delivery status of a post and returns live platform links/receipts once published.

tools.name: autoposter_get_post
tools.description: Retrieves a single post by ID including its state (drafts, pending_approval, queued, posted) and live link receipts.

tools.name: autoposter_delete_post
tools.description: Deletes or cancels a draft, scheduled, or pending post by ID.

tools.name: autoposter_list_posts
tools.description: Lists posts in the workspace. Supports filtering by state ('drafts', 'scheduled', 'queued', 'posted', 'failed', 'pending_approval'), caption text search, and limit.

tools.name: autoposter_list_media
tools.description: Lists media files (images and videos) stored in the workspace media library with public CDN URLs.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials. The opaque id is unique within this app and remains unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: autoposter_list_accounts, autoposter_get_media_upload_url, autoposter_get_post_status, autoposter_get_post, autoposter_list_posts, autoposter_list_media · Private data: autoposter_upload_media, autoposter_create_upload_link, autoposter_draft_post, autoposter_schedule_post, autoposter_publish_draft, autoposter_list_media, get_profile · Public sink: autoposter_upload_media, autoposter_get_media_upload_url, autoposter_create_upload_link, autoposter_draft_post, autoposter_schedule_post, autoposter_publish_draft, autoposter_get_post_status, autoposter_get_post, autoposter_delete_post · Destructive: autoposter_get_rules, autoposter_delete_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: autoposter_list_accounts, autoposter_get_media_upload_url, autoposter_get_post_status, autoposter_get_post, autoposter_list_posts, autoposter_list_media · Private data: autoposter_upload_media, autoposter_create_upload_link, autoposter_draft_post, autoposter_schedule_post, autoposter_publish_draft, autoposter_list_media, get_profile · Public sink: autoposter_upload_media, autoposter_get_media_upload_url, autoposter_create_upload_link, autoposter_draft_post, autoposter_schedule_post, autoposter_publish_draft, autoposter_get_post_status, autoposter_get_post, autoposter_delete_post · Destructive: autoposter_get_rules, autoposter_delete_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "autoposter_list_accounts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
